title.en: Behaviour is placed in a script, not the markup

summary.en: An inline script, an on* handler or a javascript: URI mixes behaviour into structure; it belongs in a script the page references.

en: Some behaviour was about to be mixed into a page.
I am moving it to its own script, which is safer and clearer.
fr: Du code allait être mêlé à une page.
Je le mets dans un fichier à part, c'est plus sûr et plus clair.

reason.en: Behaviour was found mixed into markup: a <script> without src, an on* event-handler attribute, or a javascript: URI. Move it into a script the page references, and bind events there rather than in the markup. A <script> with src, and one whose type is a data or config type (application/ld+json, importmap, speculationrules, application/json), are left alone.
